releaseNotes:
• ⚡ Instant UPI Checkout: Pay anyone straight from expenses and splits with Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, PayZapp, and BHIM
• 📷 Scan & Pay Any UPI QR: Scan shop or merchant QR codes right inside CleverCash to prefill amounts and pay effortlessly
• ⚖️ Smarter Balance Verification: Supports directly updated or pre-existing account balances with new day, month, and custom date filters
• 📱 Smoother Responsive Layout: Improved screen, dialog, and modal scaling across phones and tablets
